mapper.select: select stt.id as session_ticket_type_id, stt.ticket_type_id, tt.name as ticket_type_name, stt.sale_price, stt.allocated_quantity, stt.remaining_quantity, stt.status from session_ticket_type stt join ticket_type tt on tt.id = stt.ticket_type_id where stt.session_id = #{sessionId} order by stt.id
mapper.update: update admission_session set remaining_capacity = remaining_capacity - #{quantity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{sessionId} and status = 'OPEN' and booking_start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and booking_end_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and remaining_capacity >= #{quantity}
update admission_session set remaining_capacity = remaining_capacity + #{quantity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{sessionId} and remaining_capacity + #{quantity} <= total_capacity
mapper.insert: insert into admission_session (venue_id, visit_date, start_time, end_time, booking_start_at, booking_end_at, total_capacity, remaining_capacity, status) values (#{venueId}, #{visitDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{bookingStartAt}, #{bookingEndAt}, #{totalCapacity}, #{remainingCapacity}, #{status})

insert into session_ticket_type (session_id, ticket_type_id, sale_price, allocated_quantity, remaining_quantity, status) values
(#{item.sessionId}, #{item.ticketTypeId}, #{item.salePrice}, #{item.allocatedQuantity}, #{item.remainingQuantity}, #{item.status})
mapper.update: update admission_session set visit_date = #{session.visitDate}, start_time = #{session.startTime}, end_time = #{session.endTime}, booking_start_at = #{session.bookingStartAt}, booking_end_at = #{session.bookingEndAt}, total_capacity = #{session.totalCapacity}, remaining_capacity = #{session.remainingCapacity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{session.id} and venue_id = #{venueId} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select case when sum(case when status = 'ON_SALE' and remaining_quantity > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 and coalesce(sum(allocated_quantity), 0) <= #{totalCapacity} then 1 else 0 end from session_ticket_type where session_id = #{sessionId}

select s.id as session_id, s.venue_id, s.visit_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.booking_start_at, s.booking_end_at,
stt.id as session_ticket_type_id, stt.ticket_type_id, stt.sale_price,
tt.name as ticket_type_name, tt.description as ticket_type_description, tt.audience_rule
from admission_session s
join session_ticket_type stt on stt.session_id = s.id
join ticket_type tt on tt.id = stt.ticket_type_id
where s.id = #{sessionId} and s.status = 'OPEN' and stt.status = 'ON_SALE' and tt.status = 'ENABLED'
order by stt.id

select s.id as session_id, s.remaining_capacity,
stt.id as session_ticket_type_id, stt.remaining_quantity
from admission_session s
join session_ticket_type stt on stt.session_id = s.id
join ticket_type tt on tt.id = stt.ticket_type_id
where s.id in
#{sessionId}
and s.status = 'OPEN' and s.booking_start_at <= #{now} and s.booking_end_at > #{now} and stt.status = 'ON_SALE' and tt.status = 'ENABLED'
order by s.id, stt.id
mapper.update: update admission_session set status = 'ENDED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where status in ('OPEN', 'CLOSED') and timestamp(visit_date, end_time) <= #{now}
